bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/ (per-app limits, Downtime, allowed apps, Time Limit shield); springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (Screen Time pages). No app-facing SDK module.
summary: PermissionKit lets an app ask a child's parent or guardian for a communication or app-update exception through a system UI. BifrOSt has no app-facing equivalent: the system layer enforces Screen Time limits and Downtime, and no SDK module lets an app send a permission question to a parent or receive the answer.

features.feature: Creating a communication experience (AskCenter, PermissionQuestion, AskPermissionAction, AskError)
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-10, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. An app cannot send a permission question to a guardian. The request-and-answer flow does not exist in the SDK or the shell. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/permission_question.rs (AskCenter::take_responses; wired: springboard/src/shell/permission_sheet.rs (Sheet::finish reads the PermissionResponse)
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-10, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No asynchronous result channel for a parent's answer. The control socket in springboard/sdk/src/control.rs is fire-and-forget for these purposes. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

Wave 4 (w4-permissionkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell can allow or block an app and grant a time-limit ignore for 15 minutes or the rest of the day. Parent approval of app updates is not implemented, and apps cannot request it.
Apple documents communication experiences as available only through iMessage. BifrOSt has no iMessage counterpart.
Per-app daily time limits exist. They limit app use, not who a child may message, and there is no app-facing API for communication limits.

Wave 6 (b01, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The shield offers Ignore Limit, guarded by the Screen Time passcode, but it is a shell-only cover. No SDK button presents a parent request.

Wave 4 (theme-10, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No protocol lets an app describe what it is asking a parent for. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: No SDK API lets an app ask a parent or guardian for permission (AskCenter, PermissionQuestion, AskPermissionAction).
No asynchronous stream of parent responses (responses(for:), PermissionResponse) for apps.
No app-facing button or sheet that presents a parent-approval flow (PermissionButton).
Screen Time limits and Downtime are enforced by the shell but cannot be queried or requested by apps.
Parent approval of significant app updates (SignificantAppUpdateTopic) is not implemented.
